3rd party data via API

The credit bureau, the GST network and the Account Aggregator, as Sapphire Bank's Exasol meets them.

Credora's analysis does not stop at the bank's own books. Python UDFs running inside Sapphire Bank's Exasol fetch 3rd party data on demand via API, through the HTTPS relays below. 16 UDF instances call bulk endpoints in parallel, within one RUN_ANALYSIS call. Exasol stages the replies with a purge time and deletes them on schedule, keeping a SHA-256 fingerprint as proof. All three are mocks built for this demo. They imitate the real services and hold only synthetic data.

  1. Sapphire Bank's ExasolA Python UDF in the analysis run asks for a bureau report, GST returns or other-bank statements.
  2. API call over HTTPSEach request carries an X-API-Key header. Without it, data calls are refused.
  3. Relay to the mock APIThe relay hands the call to the FastAPI app, which answers from its own synthetic database.

What the 3rd party APIs hold right now

Reading live counts…

APICIBIL

Credit bureau

Consumer reports for every partner and commercial reports for every company, with scores, open facilities, overdues and enquiries.

  • GET/v1/consumer/{pan}
  • GET/v1/commercial/{pan}
  • POST/v1/consumer/bulk, /v1/commercial/bulk
cibil.<domain> HealthAPI docs
APIGSTN

GST network

GST registrations and 2 to 10 years of monthly returns per company. This is the turnover trail the bank cannot see in its own ledger.

  • GET/v1/gstin/{gstin}
  • GET/v1/gstin/{gstin}/returns
  • POST/v1/returns/bulk
gst.<domain> HealthAPI docs
APIAccount Aggregator

Account Aggregator

With the partners' consent, their accounts at other banks with transactions. These are cash flows that never pass through Sapphire Bank.

  • POST/v1/consent
  • GET/v1/fi/{consent_id}
  • POST/v1/fi/bulk
aa.<domain> HealthAPI docs

All data is synthetic

Every company, partner, PAN, GSTIN, account and score here is generated. These are mocks of CIBIL, GSTN and an Account Aggregator, not the real organisations, and they carry none of their data or branding.

Data calls need an API key

/docs and /health are open to anyone. Every data endpoint requires the X-API-Key header. The key is set per deployment and held by Sapphire Bank's Exasol, so a call without it gets 401.

Where the bank is

The other end of these calls is Credora, Sapphire Bank's pre-approved corporate loan app, built on Exasol Personal for ExaThon India 2026. Inside the bank, only the Exasol roles granted it may read the raw replies. Loan operations sees the derived features and decisions, and relationship managers see the decisions. Neither reads the raw bureau, GST or Account Aggregator data. Every reply is stored with a purge time, and the Exasol Scheduler runs PURGE_EXPIRED inside Exasol every 15 minutes, deletes what is due and keeps a SHA-256 fingerprint of it as proof. Each relay's root address opens its API reference (/docs).
